prior_evidence_used_only_for_precision_d.note: The prior result made q-dependent allele selection the leading single-edge candidate but did not satisfy the preregistered risk-resolution rule. It is used only to size a fixed precision follow-up, not to tune any state, forcing, endpoint or threshold.

operator_theorem.headline: For 0<p<1, local allele selection satisfies logit(p_plus)-logit(p)=log(0.75+0.4q), which is strictly increasing in q and switches sign at q=0.625.
operator_theorem.claim_boundary: Operator-level theorem only; endpoint-level causality is tested separately below.

question: Does the single local q -> high-allele selection edge make a reproducible positive causal contribution to the late AA-versus-RR functional-loss contrast after direct trait/allele feedback to q has been removed?

replication.common_random_number_pairing: Within each master-seed/replicate key, AA and RR share the same trajectory seed within a condition, and the same key is reused across the baseline and deletion conditions for the difference-in-differences.
replication.seed_exclusion: None of these master seeds appears in the previous pathway-edge experiment.

precision_rationale.fixed_scaling_expectation: Quadrupling paired replication is expected to halve the standard-error scale, targeting an approximately 0.0222 risk-difference halfwidth if variance is similar. No sequential stopping or sample-size extension is permitted.

primary_endpoint.definition: Existing tau_trait_realised endpoint: first generation at which realised high-trait occupancy is absent from every patch.

primary_estimand.definition: DID_40 = (RR-AA cumulative loss risk under baseline_local_allele_selection) - (RR-AA cumulative loss risk under delete_local_allele_selection), paired over the same 6000 keys.
primary_estimand.resolved_positive_rule: If the two-sided paired 95% confidence interval for DID_40 lies strictly above zero, conclude that local q-dependent allele selection makes a positive causal contribution to the late sorting advantage within the declared closure.
primary_estimand.resolved_negative_rule: If the two-sided paired 95% confidence interval lies strictly below zero, conclude that the edge is countervailing rather than sorting at the endpoint.
primary_estimand.unresolved_rule: If the interval includes zero, retain single-edge endpoint causality as unresolved and stop.

secondary_mechanistic_readouts: AA-RR difference in mean high-allele frequency
AA-RR difference in maximum realised high-trait mass
AA-RR difference in realised high-trait refuge count
AA-RR difference in mean and maximum q
stop_rule: Run exactly the two declared conditions with the fixed state, forcing, 12 master seeds, 500 replicates per seed, horizons and endpoint. Do not add seeds, extend replication, open alternative q substitutions, change thresholds, inspect alternative endpoints, or add further interventions after the first outcome file is produced.
claim_boundary: A positive result establishes single-edge endpoint-level causality only for the declared finite q-only closure. It does not establish a universal natural sorting law, and the operator theorem remains distinct from the finite endpoint experiment.
